column1: # External oracle: consonant maps from the Coq formalization paninian-verified (MIT).
# Coq was not run here (no coqc): these are the definitions as written, not proof results.
# Converted from SLP1 to IAST, Devanagari and Cyrillic by docs/upc14-oracles-converted/to_script.py using
# upc14v2_script.encode_text (commit 3785441). Sequences: tokens side by side, a middle dot only where the
# reading would differ; `|` separates the left and right part of a sandhi result. Outside the codec and written
# as literals: long ḷ (ḹ, ॡ; Kasika txt 389 says it does not exist) and the avagraha (’, ऽ).
# Round trip: every cell was decoded back and compared with the SLP1 original; the original file stays in git history.
